title: A Glitz-Free Place Named for Trump? Welcome to the Golan Heights.
summary_full: The bare-bones village of prefab homes has none of the gilded Trump aesthetic, and the Israelis there are weary of being seen as a gauge of their country’s roller-coaster view of the president.
